cover.sub: Cast brass, hand-set crystal, flame-shaped glass - bent, set and polished by hand in Guangdong. Made to order for interiors and hospitality.

projects.name: Lights
projects.line: Twelve arms or thirty-six. The piece is drawn outward from the fixture count, never squeezed into a catalogue size.
projects.alt: A panelled drawing room with a twelve-arm crystal chandelier

projects.name: Scale
projects.line: From a small pendant to a whole hall. At the far end the crystal pattern is redrawn, not enlarged.
projects.alt: A dining room with a long crystal bar fixture over the table

projects.name: Drop
projects.line: Set by the ceiling and by the height people stand under it. We cut the rods — the drawing does not change.
projects.alt: A long sitting room with a deeper crystal fixture hung lower

projects.name: Scale
projects.line: The same drawing at three sizes; the crystal is re-pitched, never stretched.
projects.alt: A double-height entrance hall with a large tiered crystal chandelier

projects.name: Finish
projects.line: Brass, antique brass or polished chrome. One finish per piece, decided with a sample in your hand.
projects.alt: A cream sitting room with a wide multi-arm crystal fixture

projects.name: Lights
projects.line: A single drum, or forty arms on three tiers — the ceiling decides how far it can grow.
projects.alt: A windowed living room with a crystal fixture over a long table

projects.name: Scale
projects.line: A lantern form needs more height than width; a wide room asks for a wider answer.
projects.alt: A seating area with a single large lantern-form crystal fixture

projects.name: Finish
projects.line: Crystal and brass are the same family in three temperatures; we send samples before drawing.
projects.alt: A living room with a crystal drum fixture and a wide window

groups.title: Chandeliers
groups.note: Ceiling pieces, from a single drop to a hall twelve metres up.

groups.title: Wall lights
groups.note: Sconces drawn to a mirror line, a doorway or a stair.

groups.title: Table lamps
groups.note: Small pieces for a console, a desk, a bedside.

groups.title: Floor lamps
groups.note: Standing pieces, balanced on a single stem.

groups.title: Objects
groups.note: The pieces that refuse a category.

plates.label: Cut
title: Every facet is cut,
then polished
plates.body: The edge has to hold light on one side and shadow on the other. Cut too shallow and the crystal turns to glass; cut too deep and it swallows the room.
plates.alt: Cut-crystal pendants hanging from a gilt corona

plates.label: Strung
title: Each drop is drilled,
checked, then hung
plates.body: In the order the drawing calls for. One row out of line and the whole run comes back down - there is no machine that makes that judgement.
plates.alt: Rows of crystal drops strung on wire, close up

close.label: Lit
title: It is only finished
once it is lit
close.body: Frame, balance, switch on. In the light the piece either holds together or it does not - and that is the moment we judge the work, not the drawing.
close.alt: The 70086 fixture switched on, its flame bulbs lit
